name: Brea Mall
summary: Clothing chain with trendy apparel, shoes & accessories for teen girls & young women.
description: Brea Mall is a premier shopping destination in Orange County featuring an extensive collection of popular retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. Managed by Simon Property Group, this enclosed regional mall offers a comfortable climate-controlled shopping experience with convenient access from major Southern California highways. The center provides a comprehensive retail mix serving the Brea community and surrounding areas.
demographics: Brea Mall attracts a diverse demographic base from North Orange County, with primary visitors including middle to upper-middle income households earning $75,000-$150,000 annually. The trade area encompasses established suburban communities in Brea, Fullerton, Placentia, and Yorba Linda, drawing families with children as well as young professionals aged 25-54. Shoppers typically seek a mix of value and quality, gravitating toward national retailers and brands while enjoying the convenience of a full-service regional mall experience with dining and entertainment options.
